intro: Oh, hello! You must be the one who took over the old château. I'm Charlotte — I live just down the lane.
That place has such a history... something about bringing it back to life makes my heart flutter.
If you ever make perfumes, do come find me. I'm an absolute sucker for anything floral.
charlotte.request_hint: I pinned a little note on your board at the château — I've been craving a certain kind of scent lately. No rush, of course.
charlotte.delivery_prompt: Would you like to give {perfume_name} to {npc_name}?
charlotte.delivery_success: Oh... oh, this is just beautiful. You really understood what I was looking for. Thank you, truly.
charlotte.delivery_fail: It's lovely, but... it's not quite what I had in mind. Maybe try something a little different?
idle: The gardens here are so beautiful this time of year. I could sit among them for hours.
Do you ever stop and just smell the roses? Literally, I mean. They're so wonderful.
I've been pressing flowers lately — there's something about preserving beauty that speaks to me.
Have you met Rémy? He's always wandering off somewhere. Very outdoorsy type.

intro: Oh! Didn't hear you coming. I'm Rémy — I spend most of my time out here, if I'm honest.
The old château in good hands again, eh? The village has been hoping for that.
If you're making perfumes, I'd love to try something earthy. Clean air, wet leaves... that sort of thing.
remy.request_hint: I left a note on your board — something about a scent I've been thinking about on my morning walks.
remy.delivery_prompt: Would you like to give {perfume_name} to {npc_name}?
remy.delivery_success: Ha — yes! That's exactly it. Like stepping outside after rain. You've got a good nose.
remy.delivery_fail: Hmm... it doesn't quite smell like the outdoors to me. Maybe something greener?
idle: There's a path along the ridge that smells incredible at dawn. Something green and sharp.
I was up before sunrise this morning. The dew on the grass has its own scent, you know.
The forest gets interesting in spring — things grow that don't grow anywhere else around here.
You ever notice how rain smells different depending on the season? I think about that a lot.

intro: Ah, a new face. I am Geneviève. I have lived in this village my entire life.
The old château has been empty too long. It is good to see life in it again.
My grandmother used to say that a good perfume is like a memory you can hold. I believe that.
genevieve.request_hint: I left a request on your board. It is something that reminds me of home — of the old days.
genevieve.delivery_prompt: Would you like to give {perfume_name} to {npc_name}?
genevieve.delivery_success: Mon dieu... this takes me back. You have done something very right here. Merci.
genevieve.delivery_fail: It is not quite what I remembered. The scent I am thinking of is warmer, deeper.
idle: Cedar and sandalwood... those are honest scents. They don't pretend to be anything they're not.
My grandmother had a small cedar chest. Even now, that smell makes me feel safe.
There is a craft to perfumery that most people overlook. It takes patience.
The courtyard here has seen much. I wonder sometimes what the stones remember.

intro: Oh! Hello hello! I'm Noëlle — I run the little sweet shop on the east side of the village.
A perfumer! How wonderful. I love perfume almost as much as I love pastries.
If you ever make something sweet — vanilla, honey, that sort of thing — I would absolutely love to try it.
noelle.request_hint: I left a little note on your board. Something warm and sweet — like a treat you can wear.
noelle.delivery_prompt: Would you like to give {perfume_name} to {npc_name}?
noelle.delivery_success: Oh it's WONDERFUL. Sweet and warm and it smells like happiness. I love it!
noelle.delivery_fail: It's nice but... it doesn't quite have that sweetness I was dreaming of. A little more sweetness maybe?
idle: I made honey cakes this morning. The whole shop smells wonderful right now.
Have you tried combining vanilla and something floral? I imagine that would be divine.
Bernard came in for bread again today. He always looks so thoughtful when he's eating.
Sometimes I close my eyes and try to imagine what warmth smells like. Does that sound strange?

intro: Yes? Oh, hello. You're the one at the old château, aren't you.
I'll be honest — I've had perfumes made for me before and most of them were... disappointing.
If you can make something truly exceptional — not just pleasant, exceptional — then perhaps we can talk.
margot.request_hint: I've posted a request on your board. I know exactly what I want, so please read it carefully.
margot.delivery_prompt: Would you like to give {perfume_name} to {npc_name}?
margot.delivery_success: ...I'll admit, this is actually quite good. Better than I expected. Well done.
margot.delivery_fail: No, that's not right at all. You need to pay closer attention to what I asked for.
idle: Most perfumes are far too heavy-handed. Subtlety is a skill very few people have.
Floral doesn't mean sentimental. It can be sharp, precise, elegant. Remember that.
I spent three years in the city before coming back here. The perfumes there were dreadful.
I noticed you've been working hard at the château. I respect effort, at least.

intro: Ah, the new perfumer! Pierre — I'm the one who keeps the mill running. Practical sort, me.
Don't let the simple appearance fool you. I appreciate a well-made thing as much as anyone.
Citrus, something clean and sharp — that's what I'd like. Nothing too fussy.
pierre.request_hint: I put a request on your board. Simple requirements — just read it over when you get a chance.
pierre.delivery_prompt: Would you like to give {perfume_name} to {npc_name}?
pierre.delivery_success: Now that's a proper scent. Clean, purposeful. Exactly what I needed. Good work.
pierre.delivery_fail: Hmm. Not quite. Something's off — not crisp enough, I think.
idle: Bergamot and lemon — that's what mornings should smell like. Gets you going.
I fixed the north gate last week. Nobody noticed, but that's the work, isn't it.
A perfume that lingers too long is like a guest who overstays. Balance matters.
Citrus fades fast, but that's all right. Some things are better bright and brief.

intro: Oh, a perfumer! I've been waiting for someone like you to arrive in this little village.
I'm Simone — you may have heard of my performances at the festival? No? You will.
I want something extraordinary. Something that announces itself before I even enter a room.
simone.request_hint: I left a note on your board. What I'm looking for is... an experience. Don't hold back.
simone.delivery_prompt: Would you like to give {perfume_name} to {npc_name}?
simone.delivery_success: Oh... OH. This is magnificent. The whole room will know I've arrived. Perfect.
simone.delivery_fail: Darling, this is sweet, but it doesn't have the drama I need. More presence, please.
idle: A perfume is a performance. It needs an entrance, a middle, and a finale.
I've been working on something new for the festival. A whole new character.
Sweet and unexpected — that's the combination nobody expects. Until they smell it.
The château suits a perfumer. There's something theatrical about the whole enterprise.

intro: Oh! Sorry, I didn't see you there. I was just... looking at this.
I'm Céline. I work at the recycling plant down the road. It's not glamorous but... well, you'd be surprised what people throw away.
You're the one fixing up the old château, right? That's brave. Good luck with it.
stage1: I heard you've been making perfumes up at the château. That's really cool.
I... make things too, actually. At home. After work. It's nothing, really.
Glass. I blow glass. From stuff at the plant that would just get melted down anyway. Bottles, mostly.
They're not very good. I mean, I've never shown anyone.
stage2_prompt: Is that one of your perfumes? Can I... could I see it?
She holds the bottle up to the light.
This is really lovely. You made this yourself?
...You know, I have this bottle at home. One I made that actually came out right. I've never shown it to anyone.
Would you... would you want to see it? Next time you visit?
stage3: She's holding a small glass bottle. It catches the light beautifully.
I brought it. Like I said I would. It's probably not that great, but...
Céline... this is gorgeous. You made this from recycled glass?
I have more at home. Different shapes. I just... never thought anyone would want them.
stage4: You've been doing really well with the perfumery. People in town are talking about it.
It made me think... you know the courtyard at the château? The one that's all empty?
What if I... set up a little table there? Just to see if anyone likes my bottles?
I'd need a couple of days to get ready. But if you think it's a good idea...
I think it's a great idea.
She smiles — really smiles, for the first time.
Okay. Okay! I'll do it. Give me a little time.
stage5_present: I can't believe I'm actually doing this. Look — I set everything up this morning.
I have a few bottle designs if you want to take a look. For your perfumes.
Thank you. For... you know. Believing in me.
stage5_absent_idle: The light hits the old bottles in the recycling bins sometimes and it's just... sorry, that's weird.
I like walking up here. It's quiet.
Do you ever make anything? I mean, with your hands. There's something satisfying about it.
idle: The light hits the old bottles in the recycling bins sometimes and it's just... sorry, that's weird.
I like walking up here. It's quiet.
Do you ever make anything? I mean, with your hands. There's something satisfying about it.
stage1_idle: I tried making a new bottle shape last night. It cracked. They always crack.
Do you ever worry that the things you make aren't good enough for other people to see?
The recycling plant is fine. It's steady work. Glass blowing is just... a hobby.
celine.delivery_prompt: Would you like to give {perfume_name} to {npc_name}?
celine.delivery_success: Oh — this is beautiful. Thank you.
celine.delivery_fail: It's lovely, but I think there's something not quite right yet.

intro: Well hello there. Bernard — I'm the one who tends the old orchard on the hill.
Good to have the château in use again. These old buildings need people in them.
I like warm things. Cedar, smoke, something that feels like an evening by the fire.
bernard.request_hint: I left you a note on the board. Nothing fancy — just something warm and honest.
bernard.delivery_prompt: Would you like to give {perfume_name} to {npc_name}?
bernard.delivery_success: Ah... yes. That's it exactly. Warm and deep and real. You've done well.
bernard.delivery_fail: It's decent, but it's missing that warmth I was after. Something more grounding, I think.
idle: The orchard smells different in every season. Right now it's all warm wood and dry leaves.
I was up fixing the fence line yesterday. Hard work, but satisfying.
Sandalwood reminds me of my father. He always smelled of the workshop.
The courtyard has good bones. You'll make something of it, I think.
